# Ajay Ummadi

> Entrepreneur and technologist in India. Founder and Managing Partner of MakerWorks Lab (robotics and Physical AI maker space, Malad East, Mumbai) since March 2025. Contributor to Hugging Face's open-source LeRobot library.

Canonical page: https://makerworkslab.in/ajayummadi/

## Projects
- SO-101 Teleoperation Studio: local web dashboard and Three.js 3D digital twin for SO-101 leader/follower robot arm teleoperation on top of LeRobot (60 Hz loop, telemetry, CSV recording, calibration manager). Separate add-on, not endorsed by LeRobot. Backend and 3D twin written with Claude Code; UI redesign and product direction by Ajay Ummadi. https://makerworkslab.in/ajayummadi/projects/so-101-teleoperation-studio/
- Open-Ear Wired Earbuds: parametric Blender Python design for 3D-printed wired open-ear earphones around a salvaged driver, plus a cable-reel case. Both ears printed and worn; sound quality and case not yet tested. https://makerworkslab.in/ajayummadi/projects/open-ear-earbuds/
- LeRobot Training Monitor: live terminal dashboard for lerobot-train (progress, ETA, loss and gradient-norm plots), about 280 lines of Python. https://makerworkslab.in/ajayummadi/projects/lerobot-training-monitor/

- MakerWorks Lab: https://makerworkslab.in/ajayummadi/projects/makerworks-lab/

- Reachy Mini: Ajay assembled his own Reachy Mini (open-source expressive desktop robot) and is planning a new app for it to publish on Hugging Face (planned, not released). https://makerworkslab.in/ajayummadi/projects/reachy-mini/

- LeRobot SO-101 Arms: Ajay assembled a leader and follower SO-101 pair and published an interactive 3D exploded view of the arm built from the official CAD (Apache-2.0). https://makerworkslab.in/ajayummadi/projects/lerobot-so-101/

- Book: "Getting Started with Micro:bit: A Beginner's Guide to Coding, Electronics, and Fun Projects" by Ajay Ummadi, Maker Works Lab, Mumbai, 2025. Read online: https://online.anyflip.com/aogwo/mjyr/index.html. https://makerworkslab.in/ajayummadi/projects/microbit-beginners-guide/
